questions.explanation: 'Who' for people in a defining relative clause.
questions.q: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.

questions.explanation: In non-defining clauses (with commas), use 'who', not 'that'.
questions.q: My sister, ___ lives in Paris, is visiting us.

questions.explanation: 'That' for things in a defining relative clause.
questions.q: The book ___ I bought is very interesting.

questions.explanation: Non-defining clause about a thing: use 'which' with commas.
questions.q: London, ___ is the capital of the UK, is very busy.

questions.explanation: 'Whose' shows possession.
questions.q: The woman ___ car was stolen called the police.

questions.explanation: 'Where' for places.
questions.q: That's the restaurant ___ we had dinner.

questions.explanation: Non-defining clauses need commas and 'who'/'which', never 'that'.
options: My brother, that lives in Rome, is an engineer.
My brother which lives in Rome, is an engineer.
My brother, who lives in Rome, is an engineer.
My brother, who lives in Rome is an engineer.
questions.q: Which sentence is correct?

questions.explanation: 'Who' for people in a defining clause.
questions.q: The students ___ finished early left the room.

questions.explanation: Non-defining clause: 'which' with commas, not 'that'.
questions.q: The Eiffel Tower, ___ was built in 1889, is in Paris.

questions.explanation: 'Whose' + noun shows possession.
questions.q: I met a woman ___ husband is famous.

questions.explanation: 'When' for times/days.
questions.q: The day ___ we met was sunny.

questions.explanation: Non-defining clause about a thing uses 'which'.
questions.q: My phone, ___ I bought last year, is broken.

questions.explanation: 'Who' (not 'whom') as the subject of the relative clause.
questions.q: The teacher ___ helped me was very kind.

questions.explanation: Non-defining clause: 'which' with commas.
questions.q: Barcelona, ___ we visited last year, is beautiful.

questions.explanation: Never use 'that' in a non-defining clause with commas.
options: The man who called is my uncle.
The car which I bought is red.
My mum, that cooks well, made dinner.
The film that we watched was great.
questions.q: Which sentence is WRONG?

questions.explanation: 'Why' after 'the reason'.
questions.q: The reason ___ I'm late is the traffic.

questions.explanation: 'Who' for people in a defining clause.
questions.q: Children ___ eat vegetables are healthier.

questions.explanation: Non-defining clause: 'which', not 'that'.
questions.q: His latest film, ___ I haven't seen, won an award.

questions.explanation: 'Where' for a place where something happened.
options: The house who I grew up in is old.
The house which I grew up is old.
The house where I grew up is old.
The house whose I grew up is old.
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is correct?

questions.explanation: 'Who' as subject for people.
questions.q: The player ___ scored the goal is only 18.
